affordance_in_statement: A preliminary report between individual u and individual v is classified as a corroborated conflict if and only if there exists a third individual w who also has a preliminary report with u and a preliminary report with v.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove the triangle structure, since it is the core task. At most, re-present the condition indirectly as a relational join over report records rather than explicitly describing a third person adjacent to both endpoints.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It scans every ordered vertex triple with three nested loops, giving O(n^3) time instead of iterating over the m reports and their neighborhoods, so it times out at n = 2000.
